title: Triple-A Minesweeper
why_read: A playful high-production take on a classic game, fun but not a deep technical read for most engineers.
analysis: This appears to be a project reimagining the simple classic game Minesweeper with high-end 'AAA' game production values, likely covering graphics, animation, and sound design techniques. It is a creative showcase more than a rigorous technical deep dive, though it may contain interesting notes on game engine techniques or shader work.
